title: Where rain goes after the storm drain

shots.text: This is where the rain from your street ends up.
It starts as rain hitting the road.
It runs along the curb, picking up everything in its way...
and drops through the storm drain.
But unlike your toilet water, it never goes to a treatment plant.
It rushes through giant pipes under the town...
and pours straight into the nearest river.
Along with every wrapper, cigarette butt, and drop of oil it picked up.
So whatever lands on your street ends up in the river.

youtube.title: Where Rain Goes After the Storm Drain 🌧️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Ever wondered where the rain goes after it disappears down the drain? 🌧️

It runs along the curb, picking up everything in its way, and drops through the storm drain. But unlike your toilet water, in most towns it never goes to a treatment plant. It rushes through giant pipes under the town and pours straight into the nearest river or lake… along with every wrapper, cigarette butt, and drop of oil it picked up.

So whatever lands on your street ends up in the river 😳
